annotations.title: Postcode · Rooftop solar and home batteries

description:
Small-scale rooftop solar systems installed and their capacity in kW per postcode for every financial year from 2011-12 to 2025-26, the running total, and home batteries installed in 2025-26.

Coverage: About 2,630 postcodes in every state and territory; financial years 2011-12 to 2025-26; batteries 2025-26 only. Current to 2026-06-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/solar-installations`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: solar_installations, solar_capacity_kw, solar_installed_total, solar_capacity_total_kw, battery_installations, battery_capacity_kwh. Omit for all.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
